title: Unifying singular value decompositions of tensors via aligned orthogonality
summary: We study basis-aligned two-orthogonal (bato) tensors, which can be written as a sum of critical rank-one approximations whose factors are singular vectors of their flattenings. As such, bato tensors admit a Tucker decomposition and a canonical polyadic decomposition that are related to each other. We prove that generic bato decompositions are identifiable and that their truncations are critical low-bato-rank approximations.
